name: Everyday labels
subtitle: Small stickers. A big way back.
description: Peel-and-stick QR labels for bottles, lunch boxes, notebooks and smooth everyday surfaces. Each label connects to one private item record.

name: Fabric Labels
subtitle: Their uniform. Clearly theirs.
description: Heat-transfer QR fabric labels for uniforms, sweaters and PE kits. Apply only to compatible fabrics using the supplied care and temperature instructions.

name: Cable wraps
subtitle: Your cable, even in a crowd.
description: Six wrap-around QR labels for charging cables and leads. The QR sits on a flat flag so it can be scanned without bending the code around a thin cable.

name: Charger labels
subtitle: Never mix up your power.
description: Six compact QR stickers for charger bodies, adapters and power banks. Attach to a flat surface, keeping vents, safety markings and electrical contacts clear.

name: Engraved tags
subtitle: Made to stay with you.
description: Two engraved QR metal tags with attachment loops for keys, bags and sports kits. The code is marked into a separate tag; we do not engrave powered electronics.

name: Tap & find
subtitle: Tap once. Find a way home.
description: Three premium NFC tags with a QR fallback. A compatible phone can open the recovery page with a tap, without framing a code in the camera. No battery or charging required.

name: The complete kit
subtitle: One pack. Every kind of day.
description: A complete labelling kit: 12 everyday stickers, 12 fabric labels, 6 cable wraps, 6 charger stickers, 2 engraved tags and 3 NFC + QR tags. 41 unique item identities in one account. The Findable Key Card is sold separately.

name: Findable Key Card
subtitle: Our most premium way to find.
description: Our planned premium finder for wallets, bags and keys, with a FindBox recovery identity. Target price: KSh 3,499. The hardware model, supported phone network, battery and locating features are being confirmed before orders open. Location finding will use the supported companion app; FindBox will manage the belonging and its return record.
